units.source_text: 正月二十日左右，天色晴朗，风和日暖。

en.t: Around the twentieth day of the first month, the sky was clear, the wind was gentle, and the sunlight was warm.

units.source_text: 庭前梅花渐渐盛开，其他春花亦皆含苞，四周春云迷离叆叇。

en.t: The plum blossoms before the garden were gradually coming into full bloom, the other spring flowers were all still in bud, and hazy spring clouds drifted all around.

units.source_text: 源氏言道：“出了正月，便须准备祝寿，大家都要忙了。

en.t: Genji said, "Once the first month is over, we must prepare for the birthday celebration, and everyone will be busy.

units.source_text: 到那时举行琴筝合奏，外人将误认为试演，便多麻烦。

en.t: If we hold the koto ensemble then, outsiders will mistake it for a rehearsal, which would cause all kinds of trouble.

units.source_text: 不如就在此时悄悄地举行吧。”

en.t: It would be better to hold it quietly now."

units.source_text: 便邀请明石女御、紫夫人、明石夫人等都到三公主的正殿里来。

en.t: He therefore invited the Akashi Empress, Lady Murasaki, Lady Akashi, and the others to come to the Third Princess's main hall.

units.source_text: 众侍女都想听琴，大家希望跟主人同行。

en.t: All the ladies in waiting wanted to hear the koto, and each hoped to accompany her mistress.

units.source_text: 结果和三公主疏远的人都不得去，只选年龄稍长而品性良好的人同去。

en.t: In the end, those who were not close to the Third Princess were not allowed to go, and only somewhat older women of good character were chosen to accompany them.

units.source_text: 紫夫人随带四个相貌漂亮的女童，身穿红色外衣、白面红里汗袗、淡紫色绵织衬衣，外面缀着凸花模样的裙子、红色练绸单衫，举止态度都很文雅。

en.t: Lady Murasaki brought four pretty young attendants, dressed in red outer robes, white-faced and red-lined underrobes, pale purple padded inner garments, skirts ornamented with raised floral patterns, and red glossed silk unlined robes; their bearing and manners were all very refined.

units.source_text: 明石女御的房间里，新年里装饰得辉煌灿烂，众侍女也互相争艳，打扮得花枝招展，华丽无比。

en.t: In the Akashi Empress's rooms, the New Year decorations shone brilliantly, and the ladies in waiting competed with one another in beauty, dressing themselves in splendid, dazzling finery.

units.source_text: 女童穿的是青色外衣、暗红色汗袗，外缀中国绫绸裙子，中间又加棣棠色中国绫罗衬衣，个个一模一样。

en.t: The young attendants wore blue outer robes and dark red underrobes, with Chinese damask skirts over them and, in between, Chinese figured silk inner garments in kerria yellow; every one of them was dressed alike.

units.source_text: 明石夫人的女童打扮并不十分阔绰，穿红面紫里衬袍者二人，穿白面红里衬袍者二人，外衣则四人都是青磁色的，衬衣或深紫色或淡紫色，都用砑光花绸，鲜丽无比。

en.t: Lady Akashi's young attendants were not dressed quite so lavishly: two wore inner robes red on the outside and purple within, and two wore white outside and red within; all four had celadon outer robes, while their inner garments were either deep purple or pale purple, all made of polished figured silk and extraordinarily bright.

units.source_text: 三公主闻得许多人将会集于此，便用心把几个女童打扮得特别漂亮。

en.t: When the Third Princess heard that many people would be gathering there, she took special care to dress her young attendants especially beautifully.

units.source_text: 穿的是深青色外衣、白面绿里汗袗和淡紫色衬衣。

en.t: They wore deep blue outer robes, white-faced and green-lined underrobes, and pale purple inner garments.

units.source_text: 这服饰并不特别华丽或珍贵，然而大体上气派堂皇高雅，无可比拟。

en.t: These garments were not especially splendid or precious, yet as a whole they had a stately and elegant air beyond compare.
